No semesters yet. Click "+ Add Semester" to start tracking your marks.
10-point scale · O=10 A+=9 A=8 B+=7 B=6 C=5 D=4 E/F=0 · flagged "Improve" below B+ (change)
Grades shown as ≈ X are derived from your marks using cutoffs fitted to your own Term 1 & 2 results. The A boundary is the only loose one. Calibrate from my results · Edit manually
Failed subjects get reappear attempts, passed ones get improvement attempts — 5 either way. Tick it on a subject when you retake the end term; it replaces the mid term and takes over its weight.

🧠 Smart Features

AI suggests breaks based on study time (45min/90min/120min)
Automatically collapse completed tasks when 3+ done
10min & 5min before blocks, class ending alerts
Vibration on actions (mobile devices)
💡 How Smart Features Work:
• Adaptive Reminders: Suggests 5min break after 45min, 10min after 90min, 15min after 2hrs
• Auto-hide: Keeps your todo list clean by hiding completed tasks
• Enhanced Notifications: Reminds you 10 & 5 minutes before class starts
• Haptic Feedback: Feel vibrations when completing tasks (mobile)

♿ Accessibility

Enhances visibility with higher contrast colors
Minimizes animations and transitions
Screen reader announces focused elements
♿ Accessibility Features:
• High Contrast: Black background with bright colors
• Reduce Motion: Removes animations for vestibular issues
• Screen Reader: Full ARIA labels and live regions
• Keyboard: Tab through all elements, Shift+? for shortcuts
• Skip Links: Press Tab on page load to skip to content
• Focus Indicators: Clear outlines show keyboard focus
